DCTL.description: Design Control (DCTL). Fields set the frame sway classification, effective length factor mode, and design type for the RC design control record.

FRAMEX.description: X-Direction of Frame. Case-insensitive enum. 'Braced Non-sway' -> braced frame in X; 'Unbraced Sway' -> sway frame in X.

FRAMEY.description: Y-Direction of Frame. Case-insensitive enum. 'Braced Non-sway' -> braced frame in Y; 'Unbraced Sway' -> sway frame in Y.

DT.description: Design Type. Case-insensitive enum selecting the design plane/space.
